title.narrative: AAU & JU 2016-2025, CSO leadership training Commission education - AAU & JU Commission education scheme New

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the program is to increase the capacity of AAU and Ethiopian civil society organisation to cooperate and exchange experience with partners in the Ethiopian society. The project had two specific objectives to contribute to the realisation of the overall objective.
These are; 1. To increase the capacity at AAU to meet Ethiopian development priorities by providing tailor-made services to private/public and civil society organisation active in Ethiopia. In the last phase of the project (July 2023-December 2024), this objective was broadened to include leadership training of the faculty members at the School of economics and AAU at large. 2. To increase the capacity among leaders in Ethiopian civil society organisations to further develop and sustain the CSOs through a more reflective, inclusive, and participatory leadership practice.
CED's leadership program is different from conventional management training programs, that have been rather focusing on technical aspects of running the organization such as book keeping, project planning and monitoring. CED's program aims are to go beyond the technical aspects towards a transformational mode, through the fostering of creative, motivated, and dynamic leaders who in turn manage staff (that produce the expected outputs and outcomes) efficiently and effectively from a human rights-based approach.
The methodology produces the expected outcomes and outputs.

Projektet har ansökt om finansiering från Sida om 28 miljoner för att genomföra programmet "AAU uppdragsutbildningsprogram". Insatsen avser utveckla och leverera ett femårigt kapacitets-uppbyggnads program för chefer och mellanchefer inom etiopiska civila samhällsorganisationer, genom ett uppdragsutbildningsprogram inom AAU/JU. Insatsen är relevant i förhållande till den svenska regeringens strategier för Etiopien 2016-2020 samt för forskningssamarbetet och strategin för forskning inom utvecklingssamarbete 2015-2021. AAU samarbetar med Jönköpings Universitet (JU), och en del av de begärda medlen kommer att gå till JU. AAU har varit en Sida-partner under en lång tid och de uppfyller lagkravet för att ingå avtal. Organisationen har intern kapacitet att hantera projektet.

The project introduces a Commission Education scheme with Addis Ababa University which serves primarily the civil society organisations operating in Ethiopia through provision of tailor made professional and skills training.
